chunks: 1631 - And ʿAbdullāh ibn ʿAjlān al-Sakūnī said to Abū Jaʿfar عليه السلام:
Sometimes I distribute something among my companions to maintain ties with them through it, so how should I give it to them?
So he said: “Give to them according to migration in the religion, fiqh, and intellect.”

key_terms.أَصِلُهُمْ: I maintain ties with them or support them
key_terms.الْهِجْرَةِ: devotional migration or commitment in the religion

ai.seo_question: How should aid be distributed among companions according to Imam al-Baqir عليه السلام?
ai.summary: This hadith teaches that distribution of support among companions should be based on religious merit and qualification, not merely equal division. The Imam عليه السلام identifies commitment to the religion, fiqh, and intellect as the criteria of preference.
